in_marathi.name: Nagnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagnath is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Naga' meaning snake and 'Nath' meaning lord. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as the lord of serpents. The name signifies power, protection, and divine grace.
